page.layout: One printed page, no text block: digitiser's cover sheet with e-rara logo, title block, rule, and licence notices, Visual Library logo at foot. Nothing from the printed book itself is present.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the printed book, so left out of main_text: e-rara.ch logo and banner, the title and bibliographic block (Scultetus, Abraham; Francofurti, 1620; Zentralbibliothek Zürich, Shelf Mark 18.6,2; Persistent Link), the multilingual terms-of-use and access notices, and the Visual Library logo. The title as it appears on the cover sheet reads: "Abrahami Sculteti brevis, sed scriptura consentaneus de imaginibus idololatricis sermo ad Christianum coetum Pragensem ... anno 1619". No printed page of the 1620 book is on this scan.
